judgments.reason: The paper describes MNE-BIDS, a software tool and technical specification for organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format, which is a general analysis method.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: The paper introduces EEG-BIDS, an extension to the BIDS standard, which is a technical specification/tool for organizing EEG data, not a paper describing the specific Braille EEG dataset.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
